overview.text: Soil_1_38 is a biosynthetic gene cluster identified by DeepBGC and GECCO, with no compound class assigned.
It spans 11 kb on contig_1 and contains 12 genes.

genes.text: The locus holds four tailoring-enzyme genes, two regulatory genes and one transport gene according to BGC-XPLORER annotation categories.
No detection tool names a core biosynthetic gene inside the agreed span of this locus.
Three further core genes named by DeepBGC lie outside the agreed span of the locus.

similar.text: This locus has not been compared with MIBiG because antiSMASH did not detect it.

hypothesis.text: The cluster may be involved in primary metabolic processes such as redox balancing or cell shape determination rather than specialised metabolite production, given the presence of NAD-dependent epimerase/dehydratase, NAD(P)-dependent oxidoreductases, an iron-containing redox enzyme, a CDGSH iron-sulfur protein, and the cell shape-determining protein MreB.

facts.sentence: Soil_1_38 is a biosynthetic gene cluster, found by DeepBGC and GECCO; no compound class is assigned to it.
It spans 11 kb on contig_1 (5,288,071–5,299,166) and contains 12 genes.
By the annotation categories of BGC-XPLORER, it holds 2 regulatory, 1 transport and 4 tailoring-enzyme genes.
No detection tool names a core biosynthetic gene inside the agreed span of this locus.
3 further core genes named by DeepBGC lie outside the agreed span of the locus.

Gene products in the locus, in genome order: CJLEIP_04674 NAD-dependent epimerase/dehydratase family protein; CJLEIP_04675 NAD(P)-dependent oxidoreductase; CJLEIP_04676 Iron-containing redox enzyme family protein; CJLEIP_04677 CDGSH iron-sulfur domain-containing protein; CJLEIP_04678 Methyltransferase; CJLEIP_04679 Secreted protein; CJLEIP_04680 Hydrolase; CJLEIP_04681 Cell shape-determining protein MreB; CJLEIP_04682 MFS transporter; CJLEIP_04683 Lrp/AsnC family transcriptional regulator; CJLEIP_04684 MarR family transcriptional regulator; CJLEIP_04685 NADP-dependent oxidoreductase.
This locus has not been compared with MIBiG: the comparison is made by antiSMASH, which did not detect it.
